steps.natural_language: Add 10 units of the urine sample and mix with the immobilized heroin enzyme.
steps.bioscript:
d = dispense 10 units of urine_sample
e = dispense heroin_enzyme
a = mix d with e

steps.natural_language: Add 100 units of the heroin drug-enzyme conjugate and mix for 60 seconds.
steps.bioscript:
f = dispense 100 units of heroin_conjugate
a = mix f with a for 60s

steps.natural_language: Incubate the mixture at 23°C (room temperature) for 45 minutes to allow free heroin/opiates in the sample to compete with the conjugate for antibody binding sites.

Wash the reaction zone three times to remove any unbound sample and unbound conjugate. For each wash cycle, add 300 units of wash buffer, mix with the retained enzyme for 45 seconds, and discard the wash supernatant.
Add 100 units of K-Blue substrate to the retained enzyme. Mix and incubate at 23°C for 30 minutes to allow the colorimetric reaction to develop.
steps.bioscript:
i = dispense 100 units of k_blue_substrate
j = dispense heroin_enzyme
cc = mix i with j
heat cc at 23c for 30m

steps.natural_language: Add 100 units of stop solution and mix for 60 seconds to halt the enzymatic reaction.
steps.bioscript:
k = dispense 100 units of stop_solution
cc = mix k with cc for 60s

steps.natural_language: Measure the resulting optical signal (absorbance) of the final droplet.
